title: grid claude settings set output
description: JSON output of grid claude settings set; internal/cli/budget.go:143 writes settings.ClaudeSetResult (internal/settings/claude_user.go:213). The app relays it unchanged (internal/slices/claudesettings/http.go:144-148) and the page documents { path, key, from, to, written } (internal/kernel/webui/app/client.mjs:732 on app 8f9b806d). from and to are the raw JSON value, or null for an absent key.

path.description: The settings file the key was written to.

from.description: The value before the write, any JSON value; null when the key was absent.

to.description: The value after the write, any JSON value; null when the key was removed.
